## Use Case

What problem are you trying to solve? What workflow or application would this enable?

## Proposed Solution

How you envision the feature working. Include API sketches, XAML examples, or user-facing behavior if you have them in mind.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've considered or used, and why they fall short.

## Additional Context

Links to references, similar implementations in other frameworks, or screenshots that illustrate the idea.

**Note:** Please open an issue before starting work on a pull request. Our review capacity is limited (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)) and discussing the proposal first helps avoid duplicated effort.
